definitions.gloss: reward money; bonus; bounty; incentive payment
definitions.explanation: Money given as a reward for a specific achievement, contribution, or desired action. Can refer to corporate bonuses, government incentives, or rewards for information.

examples.japanese: {報奨金|ほうしょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われた→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。

⟦{有力|ゆうりょく}→有力：13007_yuuryoku⟧な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}した→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{報奨金|ほうしょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A reward is offered to anyone who provides useful information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{報奨金|ほうしょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The company introduced a system of giving bonuses to employees who achieve outstanding results.

notes: Common collocations: {報奨金|ほうしょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive a reward), {報奨金|ほうしょうきん}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (incentive/reward system), {報奨金|ほうしょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to offer a reward). Used in various contexts: criminal investigations (reward for information), corporate incentives (performance bonuses), and government programs (incentive payments). Related: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧ (bonus — mainly for regular employment bonuses), ⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧ (prize money — for competitions), ⟦{懸賞金|けんしょうきん}→懸賞金：22330_kenshoukin⟧ (bounty — for wanted persons).
